theme: One concert, otherwise open — and a travel-booking clock worth beating.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan, with just the Black Keys to anchor it. The quiet is a chance to get ahead of the holiday-travel bookings before tomorrow's 9 AM board review with Mike.

needsAttention.title: Sunday board review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow at 9 AM you and Mike run the weekly 15-minute review on your shared board. The overdue travel bookings below are exactly what to put owners and dates on.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The decision was due Sept 30 and booking closes Oct 15 — now five days out. Six people across three holiday weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year, so this is the one that bites if it slips again.

needsAttention.title: Reserve the Portland Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The top-priority 'book this week' rental — a full-size SUV out of PWM over Christmas sells out, and the Pathfinder is already headed south. A refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The off-week window to drive Portland to St. Pete closes Oct 18, and you're in Portland now. Setting the two dates lets you book the one hotel night.

flagged.title: A few policy roles in your LinkedIn alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced government-affairs and US-policy openings (Lilly, FUJIFILM, Citi) — nothing to reply to, worth a scan given the search.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and newsletters — Mattress Firm, Dermstore, a Nextdoor rental, your St. Pete weekend digest.
inbox.clear: Nothing in your inbox is waiting on a reply.
